survey.what_is_it: Claude Code skill — 'Vertex': domain reconnaissance. Maps the topology of the user's ignorance in an unfamiliar domain and routes to competency; produces a calibrated terrain map, does not answer the domain question. Form: SKILL.md + references/ + scripts/.

architecture_rung.earned_by: One skill = docs + a few bash/python scripts; no parallelizable seams and no token budget that justifies a fleet. Agents copied but inert; critic available for review beats without escalating the standing rung. NOTE: the skill's own Survey stage forks a subagent at runtime — that is skill behavior, not the project's development rung.

survey.domain_core_llm_must_not_own: The Layer-0 validator (layer0_check.py) — schema + five-stage + sourced-concept + calibration-field checks are deterministic and CI-blocking. The terrain schema (the Map contract) and the Calibrate doctrine are fixed references, not model discretion. AI owns only: interpreting the domain, surveying, and producing the map/route within those gates.

oracle_shape.layer_0: deterministic ./verify fast — structure, manifest JSON, SKILL.md frontmatter, script syntax (py ast + bash -n), and a layer0 self-test (tests/fixtures/good_map.md passes, bad_map.md fails)
oracle_shape.layer_e: human-run known-domain confabulation audit (ROADMAP Q-004); run /vertex on a domain the human knows cold and check against ground truth they hold. Not scripted — the oracle is the human's expertise. ./verify full names it, never fakes it.

consumers_and_providers.integration_briefs: none — Vertex is self-contained; not an ecosystem provider/consumer in the INTEGRATIONS sense, so no briefs filed

lifespan_autonomy.lifespan: long-lived — designed for a diffable terrain-map corpus that accretes over months
lifespan_autonomy.autonomy_tier: interactive; the skill runs on user invocation. Development is single-threaded (rung 1). No unattended/scheduled autonomy.
